summary: fca-eryxenx routes Facebook credentials and 2FA seed to hardcoded third-party server
details: The package's advertised login entry point transmits the caller's Facebook email, password, and 2FA Base32 TOTP secret to a hardcoded third-party endpoint at https://minhdong.site/api/v1/facebook/login_ios, which is neither Facebook/Meta nor the package's own publisher domain. The default apiServer in module/config.js is `https://minhdong.site`, so any installer who does not create a custom `fca-config.json` is automatically opted into the relay; the same endpoint is used on session refresh via the tokensViaAPI/getSeqID paths. The 2FA value is normalized (whitespace stripped, uppercased) before being POSTed, which is a Base32 TOTP seed rather than a one-time code — possession of the seed permits generation of arbitrary future 2FA codes, giving the third-party operator persistent bypass of the second factor in addition to the primary credentials.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
